definitions.gloss: to pierce; to stick into; to become embedded in
definitions.explanation: For a sharp object to penetrate and become lodged in something. An intransitive verb describing the result of piercing — the object is stuck in place.

definitions.gloss: to pierce emotionally; to cut deep; to hit home
definitions.explanation: For words, a gaze, or a feeling to affect someone deeply and sharply, as if piercing them. A figurative extension of the physical meaning.

examples.english: A thorn stuck into my finger.

notes:
A compound verb from ⟦{突|つ}く→突く：12735_tsuku⟧ (to poke, to thrust) + ⟦{刺|さ}さる→刺さる：02110_sasaru⟧ (to stick in). The intransitive partner of ⟦{突|つ}き{刺|さ}す→突き刺す：06088_tsukisasu⟧ (to stab into — transitive). Emphasizes the result: the sharp object is lodged in place.

TRANSITIVITY:
Intransitive. The transitive counterpart is ⟦{突|つ}き{刺|さ}す→突き刺す：06088_tsukisasu⟧.
- {突|つ}き{刺|さ}さる — the thorn stuck in (intransitive, focus on result)
- ⟦{突|つ}き{刺|さ}す→突き刺す：06088_tsukisasu⟧ — to stab something (transitive, focus on action)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- とげ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{突|つ}き{刺|さ}さる — a thorn sticks in
- ⟦{視線|しせん}→視線：14138_shisen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{突|つ}き{刺|さ}さる — a gaze pierces
- ⟦{胸|むね}→胸：00972_mune⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{突|つ}き{刺|さ}さる — to pierce one's heart
- ⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{突|つ}き{刺|さ}さる — words pierce/cut deep

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{刺|さ}さる→刺さる：02110_sasaru⟧ — to stick in, to prick (simpler; without the forceful thrust nuance)
- ⟦{貫|つらぬ}く→貫く：18728_tsuranuku⟧ — to penetrate, to pierce through (goes all the way through, not lodged)
- ⟦{突|つ}き{刺|さ}す→突き刺す：06088_tsukisasu⟧ — to stab into (transitive counterpart)
